permissions.network: read only from user-provided URLs and documented proxy services
permissions.file_write: extracted Markdown only when requested or when extraction is the complete task
permissions.subprocess: bundled Bash/Python extractors, curl, Playwright, uv, and optional npx fallback
permissions.interactive: only when target authentication or browser verification cannot be completed automatically

degradation.wechat: proxy cascade, then Playwright, then actionable dependency error
degradation.pdf: remote proxy, then marker-pdf, pdftotext, or pypdf

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
